observations.task_scope: Add fail-closed release activation, private configuration/state snapshots, one-command rollback, and live circuit-health persistence across router restarts.
observations.existing_release_model: M5.1 already retains immutable versioned releases and atomically swaps /opt/codex-account-router/current, but it has no coordinated configuration/state snapshot or rollback command.
observations.existing_state_model: The circuit state store already performed private atomic files but was not wired into runtime startup, failure mutations, shutdown, or the systemd unit.
observations.implemented_release_model: A schema-gated upgrade takes a private configuration/state snapshot, installs an immutable release, atomically activates it, and automatically restores the previous release on failed start or health.
observations.implemented_state_model: Circuit failures, probes, recovery, and shutdown are persisted; restart restores health history while discarding in-flight probes, and persistence failure makes readiness and selection fail closed.
